title: DRML Miner Launches Zero-Cost Cloud Mining Platform, Empowering Users Worldwide to Mine Crypto with Ease and Sustainability
description: DRML Miner has launched a zero-cost cloud mining platform that allows users worldwide to mine cryptocurrency easily and sustainably without upfront investment. The platform utilizes clean energy and offers flexible leasing of computing power, real-time monitoring, and advanced security features.
content_summary: DRML Miner recently launched an innovative zero-cost cloud mining platform designed to empower users globally to mine cryptocurrency effortlessly and sustainably. This platform eliminates the need for upfront investment by enabling users to lease computing power according to their needs, paying only contract fees. The system is based on distributed cloud computing technology and runs on clean energy, addressing common issues such as high power consumption and heat dissipation found in traditional mining. Users benefit from real-time monitoring tools for transparency, and mining income is fairly distributed based on computing power usage. The platform also employs advanced SSL technology and AI optimization to ensure security and efficiency, making it an attractive and reliable option for cloud mining in 2025. This approach aligns with sustainability goals by prioritizing green energy while offering a cost-effective and adaptable mining solution.

title: Columbia student Mahmoud Khalil returns home to New York area
description: Mahmoud Khalil, a Columbia University student and pro-Palestinian activist, was released from ICE detention after more than three months and returned to the New York area. His detention drew criticism for being politically motivated.
content_summary: Mahmoud Khalil, a Columbia University graduate student and pro-Palestinian activist, was detained by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in March 2025 and held for over 100 days at LaSalle Detention Center in Louisiana. The detention stemmed from allegations related to his participation in pro-Palestinian protests, with the administration seeking deportation under an old immigration provision. Despite no criminal charges, his detention was widely criticized as politically motivated and an attack on free speech. A federal judge granted bail on June 20, 2025, stating Khalil was not a flight risk or threat. He was released and returned to the New York area, where he condemned the administration's actions. His case has drawn attention from civil rights groups and legal experts concerned about political suppression.

title: New Photos Show Latest as White House Rose Garden Is Bulldozed, Paved Over as Part of President Donald Trump's Renovation Plan
description: The White House Rose Garden is being bulldozed and paved as part of President Trump's renovation plan to improve its functionality for events. The project is set to finish by mid-August 2025.
content_summary: The White House Rose Garden is undergoing major renovations under President Donald Trump's second term, involving bulldozing the historic garden and paving over the lawn. Starting in early June 2025, crews have been removing the grass and preparing the area for a new paved surface of gravel and concrete. The renovation aims to address practical concerns about the lawn's usability for events, such as press conferences, where the grass caused difficulties. While preserving some greenery, the overall look of the garden has changed dramatically and appears almost unrecognizable. The project intends to enhance event hosting capabilities while maintaining aesthetic appeal, with completion expected by mid-August 2025. This renovation is part of broader changes to the White House grounds and interiors during Trump's administration.
